Latin word

discessiō

discessiō, discessiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a division of the house: a vote taken by people moving to one side

In this lexicon

  • vote

    also used · classical · Cic. Sest. 74: fieretque sine ūllā varietāte discessiō; Traupman 181: discessiōnem faciō, call for a vote; Traupman 402

Examples

  • discessiō facta est in ejus sententiam

    a vote was taken on his motionTraupman 181
